entities.summary: David Olaniyi Oyedepo is a Nigerian preacher, the founder of the Living Faith Church Worldwide, and Senior Pastor of the Faith Tabernacle in Ota, Ogun State, Nigeria. The church is also known as Winners' Chapel International. The Winners' Chapel International network of churches is located in over 300 cities throughout the world.
